name: publish-early-failure-seventh-call-site
body: The surviving publish test carries a second publish call — the folded database-only early-failure case — so tests/splice_e2e.rs has seven publish call sites rather than the six the publish-cut plan enumerates. The extra call keeps the three-argument export-era signature until the database-only cut. Upgrade: the publish cut must drop this call's export argument in the same function it already edits.
